operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: the ballistic sphere beside a 60 um tube, 320x240 and 640x480 for the costs; a 5 cm tinted ball with the pinhole 3 cm inside it, 80x60 pixels, for the straddling test

gate_ahead.claim: a medium the camera is inside transmits exp(-mu t_far) at every pixel, t_far the far root of the ray from the pinhole, in both dtypes (forms.ahead's clip to t >= 0, which no other test needs)
gate_ahead.case: tests/sensing/test_ahead.py: a tinted ball of 5 cm radius, mu 20 per metre, the pinhole inside it

prediction.unit: largest relative error of the transmission against the closed form; the line is 64 eps (1 + mu t_far max), 1.5e-5 in float32 and 4e-14 in float64
prediction.why: the exponent is rounded to a few eps of itself

control.plant: ahead returns the line's whole interval (CAMERA_PLANT=ahead-unclipped)
control.resolution: the transmission is too small by exp(-mu |t_near|), a relative error of 0.65 here, 40000 times the float32 line

gate_ahead.if_wrong: the clip is not what the chord reads, or the pinhole is not inside the ball
gate_ahead.cannot_discriminate_if: the pinhole is outside the body: the line's near root is then positive and the clip changes nothing

gate_bits_controls.claim: the bit comparison can tell: the head compared with itself is equal in every array, and the same program with the ball's speed one ulp up differs
gate_bits_controls.case: bit_compare.py on the ballistic scene (float64) and script A (float64), base = HEAD for the repeat; base = HEAD with the one-ulp variant of the ballistic scene

prediction.unit: largest absolute difference in the repeat; the one-ulp variant differs in at least one array
prediction.why: the same program on the same inputs on one machine, one thread; a changed input differs

control.plant: the one-ulp variant is the control of the repeat
control.resolution: one ulp of the speed, 4e-19 m/s, moves the position by a few ulps after 40 steps

gate_bits_controls.if_wrong: the comparison cannot discriminate and the bits claim is not evidence
gate_bits_controls.cannot_discriminate_if: the one-ulp change does not reach the final state (rounded away); then it is not a control, and the result says so

gate_merged_bits.claim: every released program with no camera is bit for bit the release branch's at 7c762f4: script A (float64, float32), the gantry, the ballistic scene (float64, float32)
gate_merged_bits.case: bit_compare.py, base origin/release/v0.3.0 against this head, one job, one thread

prediction.unit: largest absolute difference in counts (every array equal)
prediction.why: the merge adds defaults and reads nothing when no camera is attached; the study's EntryDeclaration changes how axes are found, not a run

gate_merged_bits.cannot_discriminate_if: a program's final state is insensitive to the change

gate_resolution.claim: the replay gate's comparison (the frame's counts before noise against the offline render's, to 64 eps of the full scale) catches an error of one part in 100 of its floor on every draw: its resolution is its floor

gate_resolution.cannot_discriminate_if: the draws do not move the frame (they pick the frame of three and the pixel)
